title: Mya Has the Glass
hook: Mya is sitting on the glass you need.
scene: The Ledger is parked at the curb on Central at dawn, engine still, key in. The cab is a high seat and a thermos empty since yesterday. Mya is a brown mackerel loaf on the dash — dark stripe, green eyes, one paw in the big west-coast mirror on his door. The clipboard sits on the doghouse between the seats. Amber vest, taped at the shoulder. Ali is still in the jump seat from the ride-along. Your hands rest on the wheel. You have not rolled yet.
debrief: High seat, empty thermos, clipboard on the doghouse between the seats. The big west-coast mirror on his door is how this bus sees the right. The only good look at the right is past that paw.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ledger cab: high seat, oversize door mirrors, Mya blocking glass, clipboard as the log.
